messages:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: HIGH severity: cache hit-rate drop on prefix KV pool in us-west-2. Error spike to 18% cache-misses, 14:12 UTC. Pager routed to @Nina (oncall).
Nina (oncall): I'm on it. Initial symptom: increased tail latency for chat-generation routes reported by console alerts. Oncall handover: Nina -> Morgan if escalation needed. @here any immediate mitigations we should run?
Morgan (infra): bootstrapping — checking cache cluster health and rewarm metrics. Sharing dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/kv/us-west-2-prefix-hitrate
Devon (eng-sre): I see correlated eviction spikes at 14:09-14:11, looks like an invalidation flood from a rollout. Querying audit logs for invalidation API calls.
Sam (ml infra): Noting that many requests are hitting longer context lengths -> larger KV entries. Could push TTL tweak as short mitigation.
Incident-Bot: system note: 200+ errors from /prefix/invalidate API between 14:08-14:10 (svc-account:release-bot). See logs: /logs/ingest/2089994321/stream
Nina (oncall): Customer impact: 4% of requests are timing out for a subset of premium tenants in us-west-2. Not widespread but visible SLO burn. Flagged EngEscalation.
Devon (eng-sre): Hypothesis 1: rollout-triggered mass invalidation caused cache to underfill and paging to backend, leading to eviction cascade. Hypothesis 2: a change in prefix hashing reduced KV reuse; collecting keys to validate.
Luke (sre): Running quick cold-warm metric: `curl -s "${CACHE_METRIC_API}/pool/us-west-2" | jq .prefix_hit_rate` -> current 0.82 (was 0.96 pre-incident). Dumping top-200 evicted keys to /tmp/evicted-2089994321.txt
Sam (ml infra): Can we temporarily increase cache capacity or enable aggressive prewarm? I can trigger a targeted rewarm for top prefixes. Need ok from infra.
OpsBot: command accepted: scale cache-pool us-west-2 +30% (dry-run). Confirm with `ops confirm scale  us-west-2 30`.
Morgan (infra): Confirming scale. Executing now: `ops scale-pool --region us-west-2 --delta 30`.
Morgan (infra): Scale started. ETA ~90s for new instances to attach. Recommend starting targeted rewarm after new nodes are up to avoid immediate thrash.
Nina (oncall): Ryan (support) — please update affected tenants comms: "We are investigating increased latencies in us-west-2 impacting some premium tenants; engineers are mitigating." Keep it short.
Ryan (support): Sent P1 banner to affected tenants. Also created support ticket SR-11422 and linked this thread.
Devon (eng-sre): While scaling, sharing quick grep from invalidation logs:
2026-08-03T14:08:51Z release-bot POST /api/prefix/invalidate {"prefixes": ["chat:2:usr:*", "conv:recent:*"], "force": true}
2026-08-03T14:08:52Z release-bot POST /api/prefix/invalidate {"prefixes": ["chat:2:usr:*"], "force": true}
2026-08-03T14:08:53Z release-bot POST /api/prefix/invalidate {"prefixes": ["conv:recent:*"], "force": true}
Devon (eng-sre): Looks like a buggy release job retried with no exponential backoff and hit broad prefixes. That would explain mass invalidation.
Sam (ml infra): Rewarm job queued for top-50 prefixes. Command: `rewarmer start --region us-west-2 --prefix-file /tmp/top-prefixes-50.txt` — waiting for infra green.
Morgan (infra): Cache pool attach done. New capacity online at 14:14:10 UTC.
OpsBot: scale complete: +30% capacity attached (8 nodes). Autobalancer redistributed KV shards.
Nina (oncall): Observability: hit-rate climbing? Please paste numbers.
Luke (sre): Hit-rate timeline (selected): 14:06: 0.95; 14:09: 0.60; 14:11: 0.23; 14:14: 0.40; 14:16: 0.68; 14:19: 0.88
Devon (eng-sre): That's consistent with invalidation then rewarm+scale. Noting small window where paging caused backend CPU to spike — looking at backend trace logs for errors.
Sam (ml infra): Rewarmer started at 14:14:25. Initial prefix warm completions: 14:15:02 for top-10; 14:16:30 for top-30.
Nina (oncall): Latency update: p95 for chat-gen dropped from 2.8s (incident peak) down to 0.9s by 14:18. SLOs trending back in-range.
Ryan (support): Customers updated — removing banner, note to affected tenants: "Issue mitigated; we are investigating root cause and follow up with RCA." They asked for ETA on root-cause — told them within 48h.
Devon (eng-sre): Evidence summary for postmortem: invalidation flood by release-bot -> mass KV eviction -> cache underfill, increased paging, backend CPU spike -> added capacity and targeted rewarm restored hit-rates. Also need to confirm why release-bot retried so aggressively.
Asha (product): Can you quantify revenue/latency impact for premium tenants? Need numbers for customer outreach.
Luke (sre): Quick traffic-impact calc: 4% of total requests in us-west-2 experienced >1s additional latency during 14:09-14:17 window. No errors at scale (timeouts <0.1%).
Devon (eng-sre): Next actions (in-thread):
- collect invalidation job logs + job config (Devon)
- root-cause of retry pattern with release tooling (Morgan)
- add guardrail to invalidate API (rate limit + require non-broad prefixes) (Sam + Devon)
- postmortem writeup & customer impact summary (Nina + Ryan + Asha)
Nina (oncall): Handoff: I'm going to sleep now, leaving follow-up to Morgan and Devon. Please update channel with any new findings. Tag me if reopening.
Morgan (infra): Ack. I'll lead the follow-up RCA. Devon looped for tracing and guardrails.
Devon (eng-sre): Dropping a snippet used for timeline aggregation (paste to logs bucket):
# timeline builder
zcat invalidations-2026-08-03.gz | jq -r '.timestamp + " \\t " + .actor + " \\t " + (.payload.prefixes | join(","))' > /tmp/inv-timeline-2089994321.tsv
OpsBot: note: created postmortem draft issue PM-5421 and attached timeline artifacts.
Nina (oncall): Closing incident channel, switching to postmortem workspace. Marking severity: HIGH -> mitigated. Thanks all for quick actions :thumbsup:
Morgan (infra): leaving final items in PM-5421; will attach rewarm logs and helm release diff for release-bot job.
Devon (eng-sre): Will propose API guardrail PR and add tests to prevent broad-prefix invalidation without explicit flag. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.
Asha (product): Thanks — please include a short customer-facing summary for the outreach.
Ryan (support): I'll schedule the customer follow-up after postmortem. Ticket SR-11422 updated.
Incident-Bot: Incident closed at 14:34 UTC. Full timeline and artifacts in PM-5421.
